title: Well-formed PayNow EARS requirement (control)
requirement_text:
WHEN a PayNow QR code expires after 180 seconds, THE System SHALL display an expiry error message to the merchant within 2 seconds.
IF the merchant dismisses the error, THEN THE System SHALL reset the QR code scanner to accept a new payment within 1 second.
